name: remote-terminal-link-opener
description: Click and open terminal file links directly in VS Code tabs without Windows 0x2 errors, supporting SSH, WSL, stack traces, and line jumps.

remoteTerminalLinks.defaultRemoteHost.description: Default SSH host (from ~/.ssh/config) to use when clicking remote Linux paths from a local terminal session.

remoteTerminalLinks.autoDetectHostFromTe.description: Automatically detect SSH host alias from the terminal's active title or command.

remoteTerminalLinks.promptIfHostUnknown.description: Prompt with an input box to choose the target SSH host if it cannot be determined automatically.

remoteTerminalLinks.preferEditor.description: Always open file links directly inside an active VS Code editor tab.
